content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Status: deviation (high severity, assignment)**

- **§ 16.2 (p0281)** bars either Party from assigning without the other's prior written approval, with no affiliate or merger/asset-sale carve-out for IBM and no reasonableness standard on IBM-side assignments (that standard appears only for MSL→MSL Related Company transfers). This fails the fallback and matches the walk-away pattern.
- **§ 5.1(b)(v) (p0116)** additionally lets MSL terminate if substantially all of IBM's shares or assets are acquired by an MSL competitor — a Vendor exit right on our change of control.
- § 16.5 (MSL sale/merger notice + successor assumption) and the successor/assign language in §§ 16.18 and Annex 8 are favourable and left alone.

Redline (validated, `ok:true`): adds an IBM affiliate/successor assignment carve-out on notice plus a "not unreasonably withheld or delayed" consent standard in 16.2, and narrows 5.1(b)(v) to MSL-side competitor acquisitions so IBM retains its own termination right.
